settings.block_token_unconfirmed_label: Refuse sign-in while the email is unconfirmed
settings.block_token_unconfirmed_help: A correct password is refused (log in form, POST /api/token, SSO clients) until the account's email address is confirmed. A wrong password gets the usual answer.
settings.override_sso_activation_help: That extension confirms every new account automatically. With this on, accounts created through the forum's sign-up form must still confirm their email; accounts created by the SSO client keep their automatic confirmation. Has no effect when that extension is disabled.

pending_confirmation.title: Check your email
pending_confirmation.text: Your account has been created, but you are not signed in yet. We have sent a confirmation link to {email}: open it to activate your account and sign in.
pending_confirmation.spam_hint: If it does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder.
pending_confirmation.notice: Confirm your email address to sign in: we have sent a link to {email}.
